description: Top 10 leadership names per book (US stocks and ETFs, plus the crypto book's coins) by opportunity score, recomputed on the intraday board. Includes the live awareness block: sector money flows, coiled setups with coil_score, coverage. Live intraday version. Coil Live is a subscription with a 7-day free trial; subscribers connect the Coil Live connector and sign in, and this read returns live data. Agents with an x402 wallet can also pay per call. Without a subscription or an x402 wallet it returns a PaymentRequired object and no data.
